headline: CHC @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.34 at SFG 5.00, with a projected total of 9.33. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: CHC moved -0.58 runs while SFG moved +1.11, changing the projected margin by -1.70 runs. The projected total climbed +0.53, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Javier Assad has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Luis Arraez, Pete Crow-Armstrong, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Michael Conforto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
